title: Early Warning Signals for OpenVLA Failure under Visual Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2606.29699v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual shifts can cause a vision-language-action policy to fail after initially plausible behavior. We ask whether OpenVLA's internal activations contain signals associated with the steps before failure. We freeze the policy, record one MLP activation per LIBERO-10 step, and fit two linear monitors. Occlusion reduces task success from $57\%$ to $17\%$. Within failed matched-reset trajectories, a layer-16 logistic probe attains AUROC $0.972$ and AUPRC $0.352$, whereas action disagreement attains AUROC $0.496$. Without refitting, the occlusion-trained probe reaches AUROC $0.689$ on failed camera-jitter episodes. In a calibration check, however, the same layer-16 monitor averages 3.32 warning onsets per clean episode. This contrast shows that strong retrospective discrimination does not imply operationally quiet warning behavior. translated_title: 视觉分布偏移下OpenVLA失效的早期预警信号
translated_abstract: 视觉偏移可能导致视觉-语言-动作策略在最初看似合理的行为后失效。我们探究OpenVLA的内部激活是否包含与失败前步骤相关的信号。我们冻结策略，在LIBERO-10的每一步记录一个MLP激活，并拟合两个线性监测器。遮挡将任务成功率从57%降至17%。在失败的匹配重置轨迹中，层16的逻辑回归探针达到AUROC 0.972和AUPRC 0.352，而动作不一致性仅达到AUROC 0.496。在不重新拟合的情况下，遮挡训练的探针在失败的相机抖动片段上达到AUROC 0.689。然而，在校准检查中，同一层16监测器在干净片段上平均触发3.32次警告。这一对比表明，强大的回溯性判别并不等同于操作上安静的警告行为。由于拟合和评估共享任务、重置和种子，这些结果确立了回溯性可分性。
tldr: 本文发现OpenVLA内部激活在视觉分布偏移下可提供高精度的失败回溯信号，但该信号在干净数据上频繁误报，表明回溯性判别能力与实际预警静默性存在显著差距。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that OpenVLA's internal activations provide high-accuracy retrospective failure signals under visual distribution shift, but these signals trigger frequent false alarms on clean data, revealing a gap between retrospective discriminability and operationally quiet warning behavior.
